Elite training pedigree: MBBS from Christian Medical College & Hospital Vellore (1991), DNB General Medicine from P.D. Hinduja National Hospital Mumbai (2000), DNB Nephrology from Apollo Hospitals (2006) - i.e. he trained at Apollo Jubilee Hills and stayed on, a long-term institutional attachment. Member, Indian Society of Nephrology. Selected onto the Government of India 'Heal in India' / Advantage Healthcare India directory, which India uses to market named consultants to inbound international medical-value-travel patients - a curated, seniority-gated listing and a premium-revenue signal. Nephrology at a quaternary transplant centre is a high-value specialty (dialysis programmes, renal transplant workup). Multilingual practice: English, Hindi, Telugu, Oriya. Distinctive Anglo-Indian surname 'Vemagiri Andrews' means zero same-name ambiguity in Hyderabad.
